cod_policies_limits.name: cod_policies_limits
cod_policies_limits.value: "cod_policies"."max_call_attempts" between 1 and 10 and "cod_policies"."max_delivery_attempts" between 1 and 10 and "cod_policies"."block_after_refusals" >= 0

disputes_amounts.name: disputes_amounts
disputes_amounts.value: ("disputes"."requested_amount_minor" is null or "disputes"."requested_amount_minor" >= 0) and ("disputes"."remedy_amount_minor" is null or "disputes"."remedy_amount_minor" >= 0)

shipping_methods_courier_required.name: shipping_methods_courier_required
shipping_methods_courier_required.value: ("shipping_methods"."type" not in ('courier', 'pickup_point')) or "shipping_methods"."courier_code" is not null

return_policies_limits.name: return_policies_limits
return_policies_limits.value: "return_policies"."window_days" between 1 and 90 and "return_policies"."merchant_response_hours" between 1 and 720 and "return_policies"."escalation_days" between 1 and 60 and "return_policies"."change_of_mind_fee_minor" >= 0

reviews_target.name: reviews_target
reviews_target.value: ("reviews"."type" = 'product') = ("reviews"."product_id" is not null and "reviews"."order_line_id" is not null)
